# Stepan Kukharskiy
I build systems that turn AI output into structured, editable work.
Architect, computational designer, founder and co-founder of SA lab. Working with parametric design since 2010.

## Thesis
Artifacts should preserve enough structure to be inspected, changed and continued.

## Independent Projects
- Relay: routines become portable Skills and jobs with artifacts, evidence, checks and exceptions. https://task-relay-website-production.up.railway.app
- Relay for Chrome: select useful text in ChatGPT, choose Turn into Skill or Save work, review and send the prepared message, then download a portable Skill or work snapshot. Relay Desktop is optional. https://stepankukharskiy.com/relay/chrome
- Spellshape / Live OBJ: standard OBJ geometry with #@ metadata for semantic/procedural editability in compatible tools. https://spellshape.com ; https://github.com/StepanKukharskiy/live-obj
- Drawing Analysis Engine: PDF drawing evidence, declared values, calculations and engineer approval remain separate; source/audit PDF, SQLite state and hashed results preserved. https://github.com/StepanKukharskiy/drawing-analysis-engine
- SA lab: computational architecture and digital fabrication. https://salab.org/eng

## Teaching
Lectures, webinars and workshops on computational design, AI workflows and spatial tools, including work with DesignMorphine and DigitalFUTURES.

## Distribution
The personal site owns the narrative and canonical articles. Medium distributes article copies. Relay hosts executable Skills and downloads. GitHub hosts technical sources. Proposed integrations between projects must be tested separately.
